reason: A Windows desktop automation plugin that generates a shortcut and launcher for starting a local DeepSeek Harness web service, waiting for readiness, and opening it in a browser.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 Windows 桌面自动化插件，可创建一键启动本地 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务并在服务就绪后打开浏览器的快捷方式。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop automation plugin that creates a one-click shortcut to start a local DeepSeek Harness web service and open it in a browser when ready.

capabilities: Creates a Windows batch launcher file under the user's home directory
Creates a Windows desktop shortcut with configurable icons and name
Starts or detects a local DeepSeek Harness web service and opens a browser after the configured port is ready
Polls a local service port for up to 120 seconds and displays a failure message
